question: Point out the correct answer regarding B lymphocytes.

options.opa: Its two main subpopulations are called B-helper and B-cytotoxic.
options.opb: They are the cells responsible for the production of antibodies in the rejection of an autologous transplant of hematopoietic progenitors.
options.opc: They are the target cells of the anti-CD20 monoclonal antibody (rituximab).
options.opd: They require co-stimulation CD20-CD19 for the expression of the CD3 molecule on its surface.
options.ope: It is the type of majority lymphocyte in the peripheral blood of patients with Bruton's disease.

reasoning_chain: CHAIN: B lymphocytes -> responsible for the production of antibodies -> involved in the adaptive immune response -> 95% CHAIN: B lymphocytes -> express CD20 on their surface -> targeted by anti-CD20 monoclonal antibody (rituximab) -> 90% CHAIN: B lymphocytes -> do not require co-stimulation CD20-CD19 for the expression of the CD3 molecule -> 80% CHAIN: B lymphocytes -> not the majority lymphocyte type in the peripheral blood of patients with Bruton's disease -> 95%
enhanced_information: B lymphocytes are not divided into B-helper and B-cytotoxic subpopulations. They are responsible for antibody production in the adaptive immune response. They express CD20 on their surface and are targeted by the anti-CD20 monoclonal antibody rituximab. B lymphocytes do not require co-stimulation CD20-CD19 for the expression of the CD3 molecule. They are not the majority lymphocyte type in the peripheral blood of patients with Bruton's disease.
analysis: B lymphocytes are primarily responsible for antibody production in the adaptive immune response. They express CD20 on their surface and are targeted by the anti-CD20 monoclonal antibody rituximab. They do not require co-stimulation CD20-CD19 for the expression of the CD3 molecule. Patients with Bruton's disease have a deficiency in B cells, not an abundance. Therefore, the correct answer is that B lymphocytes are the target cells of the anti-CD20 monoclonal antibody (rituximab).
